free_tier_limits.correction: The current free toolbox allowance is up to 300,000 foundation-model tokens, 20 compute usage hours, and 100 text-extraction documents per month.

rate_limits.correction: IBM publishes plan-level inference limits: 2 requests per second for Lite and 8 requests per second for Essentials and Standard.

example.correction: The Authorization bearer value must be an IAM access token obtained by exchanging the API key, not the API key itself. The text-generation endpoint is now documented as legacy, and ibm/granite-13b-chat-v2 is unavailable; use Text Chat with a currently available model.

description.correction: watsonx.ai is IBM's AI development studio and runtime for foundation-model and machine-learning workloads, with APIs for inference, tuning, deployment, and asset operations. Governance and compliance capabilities are supplied through the separately provisioned watsonx.governance service.

notes: The API and official reference remain operational. The submitted example uses a retired model and incorrectly labels a raw API key as the bearer credential. IBM now marks /ml/v1/text/generation as legacy and recommends Text Chat. No authoritative watsonx.ai CORS policy was located.
